ADR-OBSERVABILITY.agent_summary: Chose layered observability plane (endpoint health / OpenTelemetry flow telemetry / entity-state reconciliation), vendor-neutral instrumentation, backend deferred to Principle 19 test. Layer 3 sequenced first as it works against today's estate pre-broker.

ADR-OSSLICENCE.topic: Open-source licence and third-party component policy
ADR-OSSLICENCE.agent_summary: Chose Register-and-Assess: extend capability map + RIFF checklist with licence_identifier, patch_and_support_owner, deployment_mode. Assessment depth set by deployment mode, not licence type. Estate has only two OSS components (H5P, MuseScore); copyleft obligations dormant, real exposure is operational.

ADR-TOPOLOGY.agent_summary: Chose single Australian region multi-AZ with cross-region recovery from code. Three tiers (prod/non-prod/sandpit) separated by subscription + identity boundary; PI prohibited outside production. Discharges ADR-001 Condition 2.

ADR-CLOUD.topic: Cloud platform selection for university-controlled workloads
ADR-CLOUD.agent_summary: Complements ADR-005 (which set region topology but deferred provider). Scoped to UoF-controlled integration plane, not vendor SaaS re-platforming. Agent was killed during final reporting; file written and validated by line count.

STRATEGY.agent_summary: Five themes partitioning SOBC one-off lines. Top: Governed Integration on a Canonical Model (AUD 1.25-2.25M, 56%); Declared Capability Boundaries (400-730k, 18%); Consistent Accessible Student Experience (300-550k, 14%). Flagged SOBC internal inconsistency in one-off:recurring ratio. Landed in project 001, not 000-global.

PLAN.agent_summary: Two-stage: Stage A engagement WP1-WP9 to 31 Aug 2026; Stage B indicative delivery programme Q4 2026-2028+, explicitly unfunded. RIFF gates G0-G6. Critical path 21-31 Aug has no float. Surfaced unlogged gap: SA departs 31 Aug with no scheduled knowledge transfer.

FINOPS.agent_summary: Reframed from cloud consumption to SaaS licence management. Levers: retire declared duplication (Teams/Zoom/Echo360); realise licensed-but-unconfigured capability; prevent net-new acquisition. Six of seven levers blocked behind the 2026-08-21 licence baseline. No dollar figures invented; 111 TBD-WP3 markers all closed out in section 17.
